tagline: All 127 × 91cm is bed, with a raised headrest built into the foam.
lead: A big dog gets the whole 127 × 91cm to lie on, with a raised headrest and no walls to hang off.
value: At this size most beds are bolstered, so you pay for footprint they can't lie on. Here the whole mattress is bed.
intro: Cedar is a deep memory foam dog mattress, 127 × 91cm, with a raised head section built into the foam. A waterproof liner protects the core, under a removable microfibre cover.
points: A core that contours to them, rather than filling that packs down.
A raised head section at one end, with no wall to climb over to reach it.
127 × 91cm of sleeping space, with no bolsters taking up a third of it.
A waterproof liner sits around the foam, under the microfibre cover.
best_for: Big dogs who sleep long and stretched out, end up hanging off bolstered beds, and like somewhere raised to rest their head.
fit_note: One size. Measure your dog lying on their side, nose to base of tail, and add 15–20cm. There are no walls, so the whole surface counts. Not sure? Ask us with their breed and weight.
care: Remove the cover and wash it following the sewn-in care label. Air-dry fully before refitting. Never wash or soak the foam.

seo_description: A memory foam dog mattress where all 127 × 91cm is usable, with a raised headrest built in. Waterproof liner and removable microfibre cover. For big dogs.
